claims.object_text: generalized/genetic epilepsies with febrile seizures plus (GEFS+) and GGE
claims.quote: The first decade of the 21st century was marked by progress in understanding the basic biology of generalized epilepsies including generalized/genetic epilepsies with febrile seizures plus (GEFS+) and GGE through studies of large families, discovering causative mutations in SCN1A, SCN1B, GABRG2, and GABRA1.
